proc getCategories(u: uint32): tuple[cat, pos: uint8] {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Returns the (syllabic category, position) pair for a codepoint. 
proc indicCategoriesIndex(u: int): uint8 {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Packed-trie lookup of the category-table index for a codepoint; out-of-range codepoints map to index 37 (like harfrust). 
proc indicCategory(g: GlyphInfo): uint8 {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Syllabic category attached during setup (otShaperCategory slot, mirroring harfrust INDIC_CATEGORY_VAR). 
proc indicPosition(g: GlyphInfo): uint8 {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Positional category attached during setup (otShaperAuxiliary slot, mirroring harfrust INDIC_POSITION_VAR). 
proc setIndicCategory(g: var GlyphInfo; v: uint8) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Writes the Indic category byte. 
proc setIndicPosition(g: var GlyphInfo; v: uint8) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Writes the Indic position byte.
